description:
Company look-up: legal name, status, jurisdiction, addresses, registration
    date and the permanent entity ID. $1.00 per request.
      XRPL   : 1 XRP  via x_payment_signature + x_inv_id
      Solana : $1.00 USDC via x_sol_payload
      Base   : $1.00 USDC via x_base_tx

    Args:
        query: Company name, or a 20-character entity ID for an exact hit.
        limit: OPTIONAL. Maximum results for a name search, 1-10, default 5.
name: xrplme_entity_lookup
